thread:
Erin: Quick sync — midweek delivery check for Optimize toolkit.

Erin: TL;DR: quant recs are drafted but need an owner for rollout, batching defaults PR is in review, and canary evals flagged a cache invalidation regression. Who can own what? @Sam @Jules @Maria

Sam: I can own the batching defaults PR review. Will take it today and try to get it merged before EOD. Reviewing PR: https://github.com/redwood/optimize/pull/487 :white_check_mark:

Jules: I can take the cache invalidation regression. Saw failing canary test — looks like prefix-cache TTL wasn't bumped in the service rewrite. I'll triage and propose a patch by EOD.

Maria: I'll lead the quantization rollout across Dedicated. Need the benchmark artifacts (latency + quality) from CI to finalize per-model recs. @eng-ml — is the latest run available? :mag_right:

Sam: Artifacts are at https://ci.redwood.com/builds/optimize/22488/artifacts. Look for `quant-bench-2026-03-17.zip` — has per-model resamples and raw traces.

Erin: Thanks. Maria — once you have perf numbers can you post a single slide with per-model recommendation + expected cost delta? We'll attach it to the release doc and the canary checklist.

Maria: Will do. Also want to confirm rollback policy: if eval quality regresses >2% we auto-roll back to the previous pinned variant (usually float32)? Want to make sure ops and product agree. @Erin

Erin: Current policy: rollback to previous pinned variant if eval delta > configured threshold or latency exceeds SLA. For this rollout use 2% as a conservative trigger, but ops will evaluate case-by-case for prod impacts.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-canary v3.2.1 -> prod-candidates at 2026-03-17T17:45Z by @deploy-bot

Sam: Quick heads-up — PR #487 changes default batch_size to 8. If Maria's latency numbers favor smaller batches for short prompts we'll gate the change behind a rollout flag.

Jules: FYI I'm blocked until infra lands the KV-cache TTL fix. @infrabot can we get a priority merge? :pray:

infrabot: infra-priority: KV-cache-ttl-fix assigned to @Leo, ETA 2h. Link: https://infra/changes/3321

Leo: Picking this up now, will push a patch in the next hour and run the canary harness locally. Ping me if you want to pair on testing.

Erin: Action items (short):
- Sam: review + merge batching PR, add rollout flag if perf needs gating
- Jules: triage cache regression, post fix and test
- Maria: produce slide with perf numbers + final per-model quant recs; confirm rollback criteria
- Leo: land infra fix (KV-cache TTL)
I'll update the delivery board once merges are in.

Maria: Can someone add a small canary test to catch the prefix-cache TTL behavior? I can add it but want to avoid stepping on Jules' change.

Jules: Go ahead and add `tests/canary/prefix_cache_test.py` so it's picked up in the canary harness. Keep it tiny.

Sam: Left a tiny review note on #487 about the env var name for batch size. Renaming would make rollout flags clearer.

Erin: Perfect — thanks all. I'll follow up here when I flip the canary switch or if we need to pause.
